gloss: in top form; at one's peak; on a roll

definitions.gloss: in top form; at one's peak; in perfect condition
definitions.explanation: A state of performing or feeling at one's absolute best. Used for people, teams, businesses, or anything that can be described as being in excellent condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}だ。

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}で、{三試合|さんしあい}⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: That player has been in top form lately, scoring in three consecutive matches.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}で、⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Sales were at their peak, and we recorded our highest profit ever.

notes:
{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう} is formed from {絶|ぜつ} (extreme) + ⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧ (good condition). It intensifies ⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧ to mean the very best possible condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}だ (to be in top form)
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧ (to maintain peak performance)
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (a player in top form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧: going well, in good shape — less intense, more neutral
- {絶不調|ぜつふちょう}: in terrible form — the opposite, meaning at one's worst
